name: Mountain-lily
desc: Mountain-lily (Leucocrinum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 72 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Leucocrinum montanum, commonly known as the common starlily, sandlily, or mountain lily, is the only species in the monotypic genus Leucocrinum, which was placed in the asparagus family in 2009.
